slides.texte_overlay:
7 boring habits that'll make you
dangerously attractive in your 20s
Get a real skincare routine. Wash, moisturise, sunscreen. Three products, two minutes. Your 30-year-old face will thank you, and right now people just think you look fresh and well rested.
Drink water before coffee. One big glass as soon as you wake up. Your skin, your energy and your mood all quietly get better. It's the most boring habit here and probably the one people notice first.
Make your bed and keep your place clean. Someone comes over and sees a tidy room, clean sheets, no pile of dishes. It says you've got your life together before you even open your mouth.
Learn something new every day. Five minutes of history, art or science while your coffee brews. It adds up fast, and a guy who can talk about more than football and crypto is surprisingly rare.
slides.texte_sophia: Learn something new every day. A micro-learning app like the Sophia app gives you five minutes a day of history, art or science. A guy who can talk about more than football and crypto is rare.

slides.texte_overlay: Walk everywhere you can. Twenty minutes a day, sometimes with no headphones at all. You'll think more clearly, sleep better and actually notice the city you live in. It's basically free therapy.
Stretch for five minutes every morning. Hips, back, shoulders. Most guys in their 20s already move like they're 50. Moving easily and standing tall changes how people see you before you say a word.
Keep your word on small things. Said you'd call back? Call back. Said you'd bring the speaker? Bring it. People trust a guy whose small promises always happen, and trust is very attractive.
